headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: July 11, 2026**
article:
The Detroit Tigers dominated the Philadelphia Phillies 10-2, with Derek Hill leading the Tigers' offense with a 3-hit, 1-home run performance. The New York Yankees secured a 5-3 victory over the Washington Nationals, with James Wood leading the Nationals' offense with 3 hits, 1 home run, and 1 RBI. The Kansas City Royals suffered a 3-5 loss to the Baltimore Orioles, with Samuel Basallo leading the Royals' offense with a home run and 2 RBI.

Several key players have been impacted by injuries, affecting their team's roster and availability. Victor Bericoto, a right fielder for the San Francisco Giants, has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to a left oblique strain. Other notable injuries include Mick Abel (Minnesota Twins, right elbow inflammation), Zack Gelof (Athletics, right knee laceration), Mark Vientos (New York Mets, right hand fracture), and Matt McLain (Cincinnati Reds, left calf strain).

The Chicago White Sox have bolstered their pitching staff with the acquisition of Jaden Woods in a trade with the Pittsburgh Pirates, sending LHP Brandon Eisert and 1B Jacob Gonzalez to Pittsburgh in exchange. The Minnesota Twins have also made a trade, acquiring RHP Tommy Nance from the Toronto Blue Jays for C Ryan Sprock and future considerations.

top_news.title: **Phillies Fall to Tigers in Blowout**
top_news.summary: The Detroit Tigers dominated the Philadelphia Phillies 10-2, securing a decisive victory. Derek Hill led the Tigers' offense with a 3-hit, 1-home run performance.

top_news.title: **Yankees Take Down Nationals 5-3**
top_news.summary: The New York Yankees secured a 5-3 victory over the Washington Nationals, with James Wood leading the Nationals' offense with 3 hits, 1 home run, and 1 RBI. Ryan Weathers pitched 5.1 innings for the Nationals, striking out 6 batters and allowing 1 earned run.

top_news.title: **Royals Fall to Orioles in 3-5 Showdown**
top_news.summary: The Kansas City Royals suffered a 3-5 loss to the Baltimore Orioles, marking their defeat in the matchup. Samuel Basallo led the Royals' offense with a home run and 2 RBI.

top_news.title: **Cubs Fall to Reds in Shutout**
top_news.summary: The Chicago Cubs suffered a 0-4 loss to the Cincinnati Reds, marking their final score in the game. JJ Bleday led the Cubs' offense with a home run and 2 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Giants Place Victor Bericoto on 10-Day Injured List**
top_news.summary: San Francisco Giants right fielder Victor Bericoto has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to a left oblique strain. The injury occurred on July 10, 2026.

top_news.title: **White Sox Acquire Jaden Woods in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Chicago White Sox have made a move to bolster their pitching staff, trading LHP Brandon Eisert and 1B Jacob Gonzalez to the Pittsburgh Pirates for LHP Jaden Woods and future considerations. The trade was completed on July 11, 2026.
